items.docs: Cancels a previously created transaction that has not yet been settled by the bank (e.g. a pending or scheduled transfer). Once the underlying transfer is in flight or has settled, the transaction can no longer be cancelled through this endpoint.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Filter by Bank Account ID (source or target account). I.e: 5c3efbeb-b292-42ae-98c2-2a50a7829d05

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: Filter by the base currency (ISO 4217 code) of the bank account. I.e: in:GBP,EUR

params.name: billable
params.description: Filter by whether the transaction is billable or not. I.e: true

params.name: card
params.description: Filter by card ID. I.e: 5c614183-ffdd-4487-ab66-ca20d6806698

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by category code. I.e: in:meals,internet

params.name: client
params.description: Filter by a client

params.name: clientType
params.description: Filter by the type of client

params.name: closedPeriod
params.description: Filter by whether the transaction is in a closed period or not. I.e: false

params.name: closingDate
params.description: Filter by closing date. I.e: btn:2018-06-18,2018-07-18

params.name: company
params.description: Filter: Show team expenses (company=true) if the user has the required permission or only personal expenses (company=false)

params.name: companyId
params.description: Filter by company ID

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter by the currency (ISO 4217 code) in which the payment was made. It might be same as the currency of the bank account or not. I.e: in:GBP,EUR

params.name: customer
params.description: Filter by a customer

params.name: customerId
params.description: customerId

params.name: date
params.description: Filter by creation date. I.e: btn:2018-06-18,2018-07-18

params.name: description
params.description: Filter transactions with notes containing the given text. I.e: like:market

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter by INBOUND, OUTBOUND. I.e: OUTBOUND

params.name: dueDate
params.description: Filter by due date. I.e: btn:2018-06-18,2018-07-18

params.name: hasReceipt
params.description: Filter by whether the transaction has an attached receipt or not. I.e: false

params.name: hideDismissedPendingReceipt
params.description: If set to true, the transactions without receipt that have been dismissed are filtered out

params.name: invoice
params.description: Filter by whether the transaction is an invoice or not

params.name: invoiceDate
params.description: Filter by invoice date. I.e: btn:2018-06-18,2018-07-18

params.name: managementStatus
params.description: Filter by the expense status. I.e: PAID

params.name: month
params.description: Filter by transactions created during the given month. Jan=1, Feb=2, ..., Dec=12. -1 for Year to Date

params.name: movementType
params.description: Filter by movement type

params.name: paymentType
params.description: Filter by payment type. I.e: CARD

params.name: recurring
params.description: Filter by whether the transaction is recurring or executed only once. I.e: true

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by the transaction status. I.e: neq:FAILED

params.name: syncStatus
params.description: Filter by the sync expense with [AccountingProvider]. I.e: SYNCED

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter by tag ID. I.e: in:5c482f7a46e0fb0005d78a2e,5c482f7a46e0fb0005d78a2d

params.name: text
params.description: Text filter to search in `merchant`, `concept`, `address` and `notes`, containing any terms from the provided query string. In order to search for exact phrases, wrap them in double-quotes. To exclude a word, you can prepend a "-" character. I.e: Mercado Barcelona

params.name: total
params.description: Filter by transaction amount. lt (<), gt (>), btn (between), etc. I.e: btn:10,45

params.name: triggerType
params.description: Filter by transfer trigger type. I.e: RECURRING

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by transaction type. I.e: EXPENSE

params.name: user
params.description: Filter by user ID

params.name: vatPercentage
params.description: Filter by VAT percent value

params.name: withTotal
params.description: This flag determines whether a total of all transactions must be computed or not. For performance reasons, do not activate the flag unless required.

params.name: year
params.description: Filter by transactions created during the given year. I.e: 2019

params.name: billingTx
params.description: Filter by billing transaction
